title: rpm: Drop libtrust_openssl build tag
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

> /kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

RHEL golang 1.27+ includes builtin FIPS support that does not require
openssl nor the libtrust_openssl workaround, and does not provide the
symbol used by the openssl wrapper code.

#### How to verify it

Build with RHEL 9.9, 10.3, or ELN.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes containers/libtrust#9

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
None
```
